costs.q: What are the costs for seafarers?
costs.a: Creating a profile, uploading documents, and applying for jobs is completely without cost for all seafarers. We do not charge crew members any placement fees.

security.q: How are my documents kept secure?
security.a: Your STCW, CDC, and medical documents are encrypted and stored securely. Only verified employers you apply to can view your confidential documents.

verified.a: Absolutely. We strictly vet all manning agencies and employers on our platform to ensure they comply with MLC 2006 standards. No middlemen scams.
